name: 1.23.0-beta.7
notes: Ren'Py games: the game's pictures can be put in different orders: Suggested, Name, File size, Picture size, and Similar, which puts look-alike pictures together (the same character in different poses or outfits, the same scene with small changes), with the ones like no other at the end.
Picture size and Similar look at every picture once; the result is kept, encrypted, with the game, so it is instant afterwards. The order you chose is remembered while the app is open.
